name: obsidian
lore_descriptor: volcanic glass, polished to a black mirror
first_pickup_chronicle: Obsidian. Volcanic glass shaped into an edge sharper than steel could ever hold. It cuts deeper than it should — but I can feel the brittleness in my grip.
design_notes: Fills peak_floor 14 gap. High damage_mult (1.25) but brittle and magic-resistant (max_enchant 1). Weapon-only — no armor/shield use historically.
